review_method: Read the complete retained release text and all 21 retained terms sections. Bound each selected heading, dateline and complete paragraph to original UTF-8 byte offsets and SHA-256. The existing strict evidence parser accepts the selected complete blocks and their document ancestors. Browser-rendered visibility is not claimed.
prior_exposure: The reviewer saw search and web-extracted issuer evidence before acquisition. Selection and review are retrospective, neither blind adjudication nor an early-detection test.
selection: Three explicitly dated discontinuation or cessation events in the selected issuer release. The undated strategic-flow transfer remains supporting context. This is not a complete Tower historical project population or an independently verified closure census.

source.title: Tower Semiconductor Reports 2024 Fourth Quarter and Full Year Financial Results
source.publication_basis: Complete visible release dateline, not URL structure, search indexing, copyright year or CMS modification metadata.
source.source_reliability_limit: Issuer-reported historical events; the financial-disclosure context does not independently verify manufacturing events.

acquisition.manifest_form: Exact dictionary of relative file paths to byte counts and SHA-256; manifest excludes itself.

rights.basis: Retained Tower main-origin terms sections 1 and 3; preserve original materials and notices, attribute Tower and do not transfer raw copies onward.

event_candidates.scope_limit: Legacy-flow discontinuation is distinct from the later last wafer output, facility demolition or loss of all company capacity.
Last output has no numeric volume, exact day, restart prohibition or independently established permanent building closure.
Historical cessation reported in restructuring accounting context; not all Japanese fabs, a current physical state or independently measured capacity loss.

excluded_inferences: No date midpoint, exact shutdown day or event ordering within a reported period.
No canonical identity, facility-safe geometry, ownership assignment or location inferred from the release dateline.
No conversion of discontinued or transferred flows to numeric capacity, good-die output, yield, utilization or qualification.
The strategic-flow transfer to Fab2 is reported completed but has no separately established event interval in this release; do not assign it the Q4 or January interval by proximity.
No zero capacity or current closure claim inferred from an historical event, source omission or failed retrieval.
No historical system-knowledge date, blind evaluation, realized forecast pair or predictive score.
next_gate: Admit the three reviewed source-native milestone statements into a new schema-8 successor using actual admission time, with source and review hashes, full policy/capture graph verification and complete parent preservation. Reuse the existing completed-period representation; no migration is required. Keep source-native events outside current physical-state claims and preserve all frozen producers and registered forecast vintages.
